compiled_state.title: Add copy-needed tag detector to story-decomposer; auto-create one copy story per copy-needed epic
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-1 (0868): running /dso:preplanning on an epic with the copy-needed tag and populated ## Copy Needs section results in exactly one dedicated copy story attached to the epic
- dd-2 (0868): the auto-created copy story description references the epic's Copy Needs item stable_ids and gates closure on a schema-conforming artifact at <copy.artifact_dir>/<epic-id>.yaml
- dd-3 (0868): running /dso:preplanning on an epic WITHOUT the copy-needed tag leaves the epic without an auto-created copy story
- dd-4 (0868): re-running /dso:preplanning on the same epic does not create a duplicate copy story

## Description
Extend plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md so that when the target epic carries the copy-needed tag, it auto-drafts exactly one copy story per epic with title "Apply gov-copy to <epic-title>" and description referencing the epic's Copy Needs item stable_ids. The auto-created copy story's done definitions gate closure on a schema-conforming artifact at <copy.artifact_dir>/<epic-id>.yaml (where copy.artifact_dir is read from dso-config.conf with default copy/).

Idempotency mechanism: detect existing auto-created copy stories on the epic by tag or by referenced stable-id pattern (e.g., title prefix "Apply gov-copy to..." or a stable copy-story tag).

Decision: distinct(page) > 1 check (multi-page coordination-pass attachment) is owned by separate story c5ef — this task creates the baseline copy story only.

## Test Approach (Given/When/Then)
Given an epic tagged copy-needed with a populated ## Copy Needs section (single page); When story-decomposer runs against the epic; Then exactly one copy story is created as a child of the epic, the story description references the epic's Copy Needs item stable_ids, and the story DDs include the artifact path gate. Given an epic without copy-needed tag; When story-decomposer runs; Then no copy story is auto-created. Re-running on the same copy-needed epic does not create a second copy story.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] story-decomposer.md documents copy-needed tag handling
  Verify: grep -qE 'copy-needed' plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md
- [ ] story-decomposer.md documents idempotency mechanism
  Verify: grep -qE 'idempotent|duplicate' plugins/dso/agents/story-decomposer.md
- [ ] Behavioral test: positive case (copy story created)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-story-decomposer-copy-needed.sh test_positive
- [ ] Behavioral test: negative case (no tag = no copy story)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-story-decomposer-copy-needed.sh test_negative
- [ ] Behavioral test: idempotency (re-run = no duplicate)
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/tests/test-story-decomposer-copy-needed.sh test_idempotent
- [ ] Test registered in .test-index
  Verify: grep -q 'test-story-decomposer-copy-needed.sh' plugins/dso/tests/.test-index
